From now on, every order will be reviewed by two staff members to avoid such errors. We promise that this kind of mistake will never happen again.

对话标题: Apologizing to Client for a Service Mistake
中文标题: 为服务失误向客户道歉
英文: Alright, I appreciate your quick response and the solution you proposed. I hope you can keep your promise and ensure that our cooperation goes smoothly in the future.

对话标题: Apologizing to Client for a Service Mistake
中文标题: 为服务失误向客户道歉
英文: Thank you for your forgiveness and trust, Ms. Lee. We will not let you down. I will personally track the progress of your correct order and keep you updated every step of the way. If you have any other requirements, please feel free to contact me at any time.

对话标题: HR Introduces the New Tech Hire to the Team
中文标题: HR 向团队介绍新技术同事
英文: Good morning, everyone. Could I have your attention, please? Let's welcome our new backend developer, Leo. He just joined us today, and he has 3 years of experience in backend development. Leo (You): Hello everyone, I'm Leo. It's really nice to meet all of you. I'm honored to join the tech team here. I mainly work with Java and Spring Boot before, and I'm looking forward to learning and working with all of you on our projects.

对话标题: HR Introduces the New Tech Hire to the Team
中文标题: HR 向团队介绍新技术同事
英文: Welcome aboard, Leo! We're a small but efficient tech team, and we're currently focused on two web development projects. Your backend experience will be a great help to us.

对话标题: HR Introduces the New Tech Hire to the Team
中文标题: HR 向团队介绍新技术同事
英文: Hi Leo! Welcome! I'm Jack, another backend developer here. If you have any questions about our project framework, feel free to ask me.

对话标题: HR Introduces the New Tech Hire to the Team
中文标题: HR 向团队介绍新技术同事
英文: Thank you so much, Jack! That's very kind of you. And thank you for the welcome, everyone. I'll try my best to fit in and contribute to the team soon.

对话标题: Team Lead Shows the New Hire the Tech Team & Work
中文标题: 组长带新人熟悉技术团队与工作
英文: Leo, after the team greeting, let me introduce our team members and our current work in detail. First, this is Lisa, our frontend developer—she's in charge of the user interface and interacts closely with the backend team every day. And this is Mike, our QA engineer—he tests all the code we write to make sure there are no bugs. Leo (You): Hi Lisa, hi Mike. Nice to meet you both. I'm Leo, the new backend developer. I heard we're working on web projects, so I'm sure we'll cooperate a lot.

对话标题: Team Lead Shows the New Hire the Tech Team & Work
中文标题: 组长带新人熟悉技术团队与工作
英文: Nice to meet you too, Leo! Welcome! Yes, we'll work closely—when you finish the backend interface, I'll connect it to the frontend page. If you have any questions about frontend requirements, just let me know.

对话标题: Team Lead Shows the New Hire the Tech Team & Work
中文标题: 组长带新人熟悉技术团队与工作
英文: Welcome to the team, Leo! I'll test your backend code later, and I'll send you the test report if I find any issues. It's great to have another backend colleague to work with.

对话标题: Team Lead Shows the New Hire the Tech Team & Work
中文标题: 组长带新人熟悉技术团队与工作
英文: Perfect. Our main tech stack for the current projects is React for frontend, Node.js and Java for backend, and MySQL for the database. Right now, we're working on a new user system project, which needs to add login and user information management features.

对话标题: Team Lead Shows the New Hire the Tech Team & Work
中文标题: 组长带新人熟悉技术团队与工作
英文: Got it, thank you for the detailed introduction. I'm familiar with Java, MySQL and a little Node.js, so I think I can keep up quickly. Do I need to read the project document first before starting work?

对话标题: Team Lead Shows the New Hire the Tech Team & Work
中文标题: 组长带新人熟悉技术团队与工作
英文: Yes, I'll send you the project document via the team chat later. Lisa will also help you understand the frontend requirements. Take your time today, and we can start the specific work tomorrow.

对话标题: Team Lead Shows the New Hire the Tech Team & Work
中文标题: 组长带新人熟悉技术团队与工作
英文: OK, that sounds good. Thank you so much for your help!

对话标题: Standup with Team Lead & Critical Blocker Discussion
中文标题: 与组长站会并讨论关键阻塞
英文: Thanks, everyone. Lisa, I'll follow up with the design team directly to get the icon set—they might have missed your message. [Your Name], prioritize the API performance optimization so Mike can start testing it as soon as possible. Remember, our sprint goal is to have the user management module ready for UAT by the end of this week, so let's stay on track. Any other quick updates? No? Alright, the standup is over. If you have any detailed issues, let's discuss them after this.

对话标题: Standup with Team Lead & Critical Blocker Discussion
中文标题: 与组长站会并讨论关键阻塞
英文: Got it. Thanks.

对话标题: Handling a Code Mistake
中文标题: 处理代码失误
英文: I appreciate you reporting this promptly. Hiding mistakes only makes them worse. Can you explain what happened in detail? How severe is the impact, and have you identified the root cause?

对话标题: Handling a Code Mistake
中文标题: 处理代码失误
英文: Absolutely. Yesterday afternoon, I was merging my code for the user profile query API into the main branch. I was in a hurry to finish before the end of the workday and forgot to run the full integration test—only did a quick unit test. The bug is in the SQL query statement: I missed a WHERE clause when joining two tables, which causes the query to return all user data instead of the specific user's data. Right now, it only affects the test environment; the production environment isn't impacted because we haven't deployed the latest code yet.

对话标题: Handling a Code Mistake
中文标题: 处理代码失误
英文: Good, at least it's not in production. What's your plan to fix it? And how will you prevent this from happening again?

对话标题: Handling a Code Mistake
中文标题: 处理代码失误
英文: I've already identified the error and written the fix— I added the missing WHERE clause and tested it locally; all test cases pass. I'll submit a patch to the main branch in 10 minutes, then run the full integration test to ensure there are no other issues. After that, I'll notify the QA team to retest the user data query function. To prevent this, I'll set a reminder to run full integration tests before every merge, and I'll ask a colleague to do a quick code review for critical modules. I'm truly sorry for the delay this has caused to the test schedule.

对话标题: Handling a Code Mistake
中文标题: 处理代码失误
英文: That's a solid plan. Taking responsibility and acting quickly is what matters. Make sure you follow through on the prevention measures—code reviews and full tests are non-negotiable for backend development. Keep me updated once the patch is submitted and tested.

对话标题: Handling a Code Mistake
中文标题: 处理代码失误
英文: Thank you for your understanding. I will definitely follow through, and I'll update you as soon as it's done.

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: This is critical—our users rely on the platform for daily operations. What's the current status? Have you found any clues about the cause? And how long do you estimate it will take to resolve?

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: We're still in the initial troubleshooting phase. So far, we've checked the server logs and found that the crash was caused by a memory leak in the latest feature we deployed yesterday— the new data processing module is not releasing memory properly, which led to the server running out of memory and crashing. We've temporarily restarted the application server to restore access for users—service should be back up in 5 minutes. However, this is a temporary fix; we need to fix the memory leak to prevent the outage from happening again.

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: Good, restoring service first is the priority. Assign one member of the team to monitor the server after the restart, and the rest focus on fixing the memory leak. Have you notified the product team to inform users about the temporary outage?

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: Yes, I've already informed the product manager—they're drafting a notification to send to users via email and in-app message, explaining the situation and apologizing for the inconvenience. As for the memory leak fix, our backend developers are reviewing the code for the data processing module now. We estimate we can identify the exact location of the leak in 30 minutes, fix it in an hour, and deploy the patch to production within 2 hours.

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: Keep me updated every 15 minutes. Once the patch is deployed, run a full load test to ensure the memory leak is completely fixed. Also, after this incident, we need to conduct a root cause analysis and update our deployment process—we should add a load test for new features before deploying to production to catch issues like this early.

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: Understood. I'll send you updates every 15 minutes, and we'll start the root cause analysis once the incident is resolved. We'll also revise the deployment process to include load testing for new modules.

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: Great. Focus on resolving the incident first—let's minimize the impact on users.

对话标题: Handling a Technical Incident
中文标题: 处理技术故障事件
英文: Will do.

对话标题: Fresh Graduate Interview
中文标题: 应届生面试
英文: Now let's talk about your weaknesses. Every person has shortcomings, and I'd like to hear you talk about one of yours honestly.

对话标题: Fresh Graduate Interview
中文标题: 应届生面试
英文: Thank you for asking. I think it's important to be honest about my weaknesses. One of my weaknesses is that I used to be too focused on perfecting every small detail when doing tasks, which sometimes made me spend too much time on minor things and affect the overall progress.

对话标题: Fresh Graduate Interview
中文标题: 应届生面试
英文: That's a common issue for many new graduates. Have you done anything to improve this problem?

对话标题: Fresh Graduate Interview
中文标题: 应届生面试
英文: Yes, I've realized this shortcoming and taken active steps to change it. I learned to make clear task plans before starting work, set priorities for each part, and distinguish between key tasks and minor details. I also set time limits for each stage to avoid getting stuck on small things. Now I can balance quality and efficiency much better.

对话标题: Fresh Graduate Interview
中文标题: 应届生面试
英文: It's great that you can recognize your problem and make improvements actively. That shows you're a self-aware and motivated person.

对话标题: Fresh Graduate Interview
中文标题: 应届生面试
英文: Thank you. I believe constantly reflecting on myself and improving my weaknesses is the best way to grow, whether in study or work.

对话标题: Experienced Professional Interview
中文标题: 职场人士面试
英文: What would you say is your biggest weakness in your work? We want to know how you evaluate yourself and deal with your flaws.

对话标题: Experienced Professional Interview
中文标题: 职场人士面试
英文: I acknowledge that I used to struggle with delegating tasks. I prefer to handle important work by myself because I worry that assigning work to others may lead to mistakes or inconsistent standards, so I often take on too much work at the same time.

对话标题: Experienced Professional Interview
中文标题: 职场人士面试
英文: That shows you're responsible, but it can also make you overworked and affect team collaboration. How have you improved this?

对话标题: Experienced Professional Interview
中文标题: 职场人士面试
英文: You're totally right. Later, I learned that trusting teammates and reasonable task delegation are crucial for team efficiency. I started training my delegation skills: I clearly explain task requirements and deadlines, check progress regularly instead of taking over all work, and fully trust my teammates' abilities. I also learned to communicate more with team members to divide work reasonably.

对话标题: Experienced Professional Interview
中文标题: 职场人士面试
英文: Now I've made huge progress. I can delegate tasks properly, focus on my core responsibilities, and the whole team works more efficiently. I keep reminding myself to keep improving this skill and maintain better teamwork.

对话标题: Experienced Professional Interview
中文标题: 职场人士面试
英文: It's impressive that you can sum up your experience and adjust your working style. This kind of growth mindset is very valuable for our team.

对话标题: For Career Growth
中文标题: 求职理由：职业成长
英文: I see on your resume that you worked at your previous company for one year. Could you tell me why you decided to leave that job and apply for this position?

对话标题: For Career Growth
中文标题: 求职理由：职业成长
英文: I'm really grateful for the experience and training I got from my last job. It taught me a lot about basic work skills and team collaboration, and I really appreciate the opportunities the company gave me as a fresh graduate.

对话标题: For Career Growth
中文标题: 求职理由：职业成长
英文: I'm glad to hear you had a positive experience there. So what made you want to make a job change now?

对话标题: For Career Growth
中文标题: 求职理由：职业成长
英文: The main reason is that I want to pursue better career growth and more challenging work. My previous role was relatively routine, with limited space for learning new skills and taking on more responsibilities. I've been eager to expand my abilities and grow in a more dynamic and fast-paced environment.

对话标题: For Career Growth
中文标题: 求职理由：职业成长
英文: Your company has an excellent reputation in this industry, and this position aligns perfectly with my career goals. I'm looking forward to taking on more challenging tasks, learning more professional knowledge, and making bigger progress here.

对话标题: For Career Growth
中文标题: 求职理由：职业成长
英文: That's a very positive and clear goal. We value employees who are motivated to grow and improve themselves. It's good that you have a clear plan for your career.

对话标题: For Career Growth
中文标题: 求职理由：职业成长
英文: Thank you. I always believe that choosing a job that fits my long-term development is the most important thing, and I'm truly passionate about this position.

对话标题: For New Challenges & Better Fit
中文标题: 求职理由：新挑战与更合适的匹配
英文: Can you walk me through why you left your previous full-time position? We'd like to understand your career choices and motivations.

对话标题: For New Challenges & Better Fit
中文标题: 求职理由：新挑战与更合适的匹配
英文: I spent three years at my last company, and I'm very thankful for the trust and opportunities my former team and leader gave me. I completed several key projects there and accumulated rich experience in project management and technical work.

对话标题: For New Challenges & Better Fit
中文标题: 求职理由：新挑战与更合适的匹配
英文: It sounds like you had a solid experience. So what caused you to make a career move at this stage?

对话标题: For New Challenges & Better Fit
中文标题: 求职理由：新挑战与更合适的匹配
英文: After three years, I felt I had fully mastered the core work of that role, and I was ready for new challenges and greater responsibilities. The previous role had a relatively fixed scope of work, and I wanted to step out of my comfort zone to develop more comprehensively.

对话标题: For New Challenges & Better Fit
中文标题: 求职理由：新挑战与更合适的匹配
英文: Besides that, I'm also looking for a company with a better cultural fit and more development prospects. Your company focuses on innovation and employee growth, which matches my career pursuit perfectly. I left my last job on very good terms, and this is a positive career choice for me to reach a higher level.

对话标题: For New Challenges & Better Fit
中文标题: 求职理由：新挑战与更合适的匹配
英文: We appreciate your positive attitude and respect for your former employer. Badmouthing a previous company is a big red flag for us, and your answer is very professional.

对话标题: For New Challenges & Better Fit
中文标题: 求职理由：新挑战与更合适的匹配
英文: Thank you. I always think it's important to stay respectful and grateful no matter where you work. I'm ready to bring my experience and enthusiasm to this new role and contribute to the team.

对话标题: Confirming Basic Salary and Payment Date
中文标题: 确认基本薪资与发薪日
英文: Welcome to join our team. Today we will confirm your formal employment treatment in detail.

对话标题: Confirming Basic Salary and Payment Date
中文标题: 确认基本薪资与发薪日
英文: Thank you very much. I hope we can make all items clear in advance to avoid later misunderstandings.

对话标题: Confirming Basic Salary and Payment Date
中文标题: 确认基本薪资与发薪日
英文: Sure. Your monthly basic salary is fixed, and performance bonus will be settled according to your monthly work evaluation. The company will transfer the full salary to your bank account on the tenth working day of each month without delay.

对话标题: Confirming Basic Salary and Payment Date
中文标题: 确认基本薪资与发薪日
英文: Got it, that is quite clear. I also want to confirm whether overtime allowance is calculated separately.

对话标题: Confirming Basic Salary and Payment Date
中文标题: 确认基本薪资与发薪日
英文: Yes, all overtime work will be recorded officially, and corresponding overtime subsidy will be issued together with monthly salary. We follow standard labor rules strictly.

对话标题: Confirming Basic Salary and Payment Date
中文标题: 确认基本薪资与发薪日
英文: That sounds reasonable. I have no doubts about the salary part for now.

对话标题: Confirming Basic Salary and Payment Date
中文标题: 确认基本薪资与发薪日
英文: Great. We will sort out a written document for you to sign later.

对话标题: Asking About Benefits and Leave Policy
中文标题: 询问福利与休假制度
英文: Apart from salary, I also hope to learn more about company benefits and vacation rules.

对话标题: Asking About Benefits and Leave Policy
中文标题: 询问福利与休假制度
英文: No problem. The company provides complete social insurance and commercial insurance for all official employees. Besides, you can enjoy regular festival gifts, annual physical examination and remote working subsidies.

对话标题: Asking About Benefits and Leave Policy
中文标题: 询问福利与休假制度
英文: That is really thoughtful. How many days of annual leave can I enjoy every year?

对话标题: Asking About Benefits and Leave Policy
中文标题: 询问福利与休假制度
英文: New employees are entitled to ten days of annual leave per year, plus legal public holidays. You can apply for leave freely as long as you finish handover work in advance.

对话标题: Asking About Benefits and Leave Policy
中文标题: 询问福利与休假制度
英文: I totally understand all these rules now. All the welfare arrangements meet my expectations.

对话标题: Asking About Benefits and Leave Policy
中文标题: 询问福利与休假制度
英文: We will keep optimizing employee benefits. If you have any other questions later, feel free to contact me anytime.

对话标题: Asking About Benefits and Leave Policy
中文标题: 询问福利与休假制度
英文: Thanks a lot for your patient explanation. I confirm and accept all the above salary and benefit terms.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: Now, do you have any questions for me about this position, the team, or our company? Feel free to ask anything you want to know.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: Thank you for giving me this chance to ask questions. I do have a few things I'd like to know more about, to get a clearer understanding of this role.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: Of course, go ahead. I'm happy to answer all your questions.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: First, could you tell me more about the daily responsibilities of this position? I'd like to know what the core tasks are, and what key projects I would be involved in if I join the team.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: Sure. This role mainly involves daily project coordination, client communication, and data sorting. You'll work closely with the marketing and technical teams, and take charge of small-to-medium projects independently after the probation period.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: That sounds very clear. Thank you. Besides that, I wonder what the team's working style is like? Is it more collaborative or independent? And is there a mentor to guide new employees during the onboarding period?

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: We have a very friendly and collaborative team. We value teamwork and mutual support. Every new hire will have a dedicated mentor to help with training and work guidance for the first three months, so you won't feel lost when you start.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: I have one last question. What qualities or skills are you most looking for in the ideal candidate for this role?

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: We hope the candidate is responsible, proactive, and good at communication. Professional skills are important, but a positive attitude and teamwork spirit matter more to us.

对话标题: Asking Basic Job & Team Questions
中文标题: 询问岗位与团队基本情况
英文: Thank you so much for your detailed answers. All my questions are answered now, and I have a much better understanding of this position.

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: We've covered most parts of the interview. Do you have any questions or concerns you'd like to raise with me?

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: Yes, I do. Thank you. I'm very interested in this position, and I have a few questions about career development and some small concerns to confirm.

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: Feel free to speak your mind. We encourage open communication here.

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: First, I'd like to ask about the growth path for this role. Are there clear promotion opportunities or further training programs for employees to improve their professional skills?

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: We have a complete promotion system and regular skill training sessions. Employees can get promoted based on their performance and working experience, and we also support external training and certification if needed.

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: That's great to hear. I also have a small concern. I noticed the job description mentions occasional overtime during busy periods. Could you clarify how often that usually happens, and is there any compensation or time off in lieu for overtime work?

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: That's a very reasonable concern. Overtime only happens a few times a year during peak project seasons, not a regular thing. We offer overtime pay or compensatory time off for any extra work, and we strictly follow labor laws to protect employees'rights.

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: Thank you for clarifying that. It puts my mind at ease.

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: what's the biggest challenge of this role in the near future?

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: The main challenge will be adapting to multiple projects at the same time and handling urgent tasks efficiently. But with the team's support and proper training, you'll get used to it quickly.

对话标题: Asking About Development & Raising Mild Concerns
中文标题: 询问发展空间并提出轻微顾虑
英文: I understand. Thank you for your honest and detailed answers. I don't have any more questions now.

对话标题: Standard Asking for Next Steps
中文标题: 常规询问后续流程
课程: L05 Asking About the Next Steps
英文: Thank you for your time today. We've had a great conversation. Do you have any final questions for me?

对话标题: Standard Asking for Next Steps
中文标题: 常规询问后续流程
课程: L05 Asking About the Next Steps
英文: Yes, thank you. I'm very interested in this position, so I'd like to ask about the next steps in the interview process. Could you please let me know what to expect moving forward?

对话标题: Standard Asking for Next Steps
中文标题: 常规询问后续流程
课程: L05 Asking About the Next Steps
